Bright daytime laboratory, clean white background and white walls, soft natural sunlight, teal, orange and navy accents. Scene: on the white floor of the lab, fifteen blank formula cards are spread out in three rows, connected to each other by thin teal threads like a map. Behind them stands a small friendly pixel machine with a fish-shaped intake on one side and a tag outlet on the other, its side panel open to show empty slots waiting for the cards. A small wooden fish-shop crate with a few silver fish sits at the edge. Characters: a calm girl intern with long straight jet-black hair, charcoal-black maid dress with large gray bow, sparkling eyes, tying a teal thread between two cards; a gentle girl intern with long ash-beige wavy hair, white frilled maid headband, camel cardigan, thinking with a finger on her chin, holding the other end of the thread; a girl researcher with long pink hair with two round buns and a navy streak, blue eyes, white lab coat over lavender hoodie, nervous with a drop of sweat, holding one silver fish in both hands; a chibi scientist with thin teal rectangular glasses, spiky black hair with one white streak, small ponytail at the back, white lab coat over black vest and tie, pointing at the card map; an anthropomorphic fruit fly researcher, black body, big red compound eyes, blue helmet with a gold stripe and pink and blue cables, white lab coat over a black vest, black gloves, transparent wings, holding up a pixel arrow sign as if saying "try pressing this"; a boxy beige retro CRT-monitor robot, dark green screen face with mint pixel eyes and mouth, short antenna topped with a red-brown abacus bead, gray segmented arms, two small tank treads, carrying a stack of blank cards proudly. Mood: the start of a study adventure, calm and bright.
